## The AclaraONE Advantage: Enhanced Meter Data Management and Monitoring is Here

Smarter tools. Personalized insights. Unlock total network visibility
with our Enhanced AclaraONE platform.

[Request Demo][41]

Better navigate today's challenges and meet tomorrow's demands by elevating your existing automated
metering infrastructure with the latest technology.

[Learn More][42]

## The Aclara advantage

Accelerate change with smart utility solutions to transform your electric, water, and gas networks.
Deliver the actionable insights your distribution network needs to create a more efficient,
responsive, resilient, and reliable infrastructure.

##### Distributed generation

##### Fault / Outage management

##### Load monitoring

##### Distribution Automation

## Enhance your utility distribution network's agility

Harness your automated metering infrastructure (AMI) technologies and edge intelligence applications
to run your distribution operations more efficiently and reliably.

[[Electric]][43]

#### Electric

Leverage the power - and investment - of your AMI system

[Learn More][44]
[[Water]][45]

#### Water

Clarity and command over your municipal water system

[Learn More][46]
[[Gas]][47]

#### Gas

Smart systems and tools for your gas distribution network

[Learn More][48]
[[Combo]][49]

#### Combo

Custom solutions for any challenge and every need

[Learn More][50]

## Discover solutions that work for you and your customers

Integrate innovative edge devices and secure software programs to elevate your network visibility
and communications. Predict, plan, and respond to network conditions with our end-to-end smart
infrastructure solutions.

[[Enhanced Utility]][51]

#### Enhanced Utility

Gain actionable insights with advanced hardware solutions backed by our robust software platforms.
Monitor, manage, and control assets with real-time visibility to optimize operations.

[Explore Products][61]

Explore our resources page and discover how Aclara's smart utility solutions are accelerating

## Together, we build efficient, optimised, and sustainable solutions

For 80 years, Kamstrup has striven to make every measurement matter. Through collaboration and
innovation, we develop smart metering solutions that protect water, secure energy, and optimise
performance while reducing costs.

By empowering utilities and building performance managers to act with confidence, not guesswork, we
take operational efficiency and resource management beyond today's standards.

**We Make What You Measure Matter**

[About Kamstrup][58]
Watch video

## Stories from our customers 

Explore our case stories and discover how, together with our customers, we have pushed the
boundaries of modern metering through innovation and dedication. 
[Customer references][59]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW2]

#### Reversing water loss in a rural municipality

With a 51% water loss equivalent to 750 million litres annually, Oneida was in serious trouble.
However, despite topographical challenges and limited resources, Kamstrup quickly helped the
municipality bounce back and become a source of inspiration for other utilities. 
][60]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW4]

#### Solrød Forsyning lowers return temperature with RTO

Using Kamstrup's Return Temperature Optimizer (RTO), Solrød Forsyning gets help identifying errors
in both old and new heating installations thus optimising the district heating network and
increasing customer satisfaction. 
][61]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW8]

#### Prepaid electricity helps Lephalale municipality to evolve

Using smart prepaid meters, a South African municipality was able to curb meter tampering, prevent
electricity theft, and recover significant revenue losses.The community now enjoys better resource
management, flexible payment options, and improved power supply reliability.
][62]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW6]

#### Reliable cooling for cutting-edge research

Aarhus University’s ASTRID2 particle accelerator depends on precise, high-frequency data from
Kamstrup cooling meters to maintain optimal 24/7 operation. This seamless integration ensures
continuous uptime and enhanced energy efficiency, supporting groundbreaking research in a
sustainable way.
][63]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW]

#### How digital meters save Vacarisses water, money, and time

Challenged by severe water loss, Vacarisses municipality replaced its mechanical water meters with
ultrasonic Kamstrup meters. The upgrade didn’t just reduce the water loss – it also helped the local
water utility by optimizing operations while reducing expenses. 
][64]

Get a virtual or physical Visa card. Top it up with Bitcoin, digital euros, or stablecoins.

Pay online, in stores, with Apple Pay, Google Pay, payment ring, smartwatch, or Swatch Pay.

## Cash at ATMs.

Withdraw cash worldwide with your physical Visa card.

Connect Nuri to ChatGPT, Claude, and more. Let AI analyse your spending, prepare payments, and pay

## Buy and exchange Bitcoin, euros, and dollars.

Buy Bitcoin with Apple Pay or Google Pay. Swap Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies—including digital
euros and stablecoins—directly in your wallet.

## Send and receive euros, dollars, Bitcoin and stablecoins.

Send and receive euros, dollars, Bitcoin and stablecoins directly from your wallet. Fast, simple,
and without a bank.

## Pay and get paid by bank transfer, crypto, or mobile money.

Verify your identity once to get your own EU IBAN, linked directly to your wallet. Send and receive
SEPA and USD ACH transfers, and send money to M-PESA and other mobile money networks.

## Visa card for Bitcoin and euros.

Get a virtual or physical Visa card. Top it up with Bitcoin, digital euros, or stablecoins.

## Pay worldwide.

Pay online, in stores, with Apple Pay, Google Pay, payment ring, smartwatch, or Swatch Pay.

## Cash at ATMs.

Withdraw cash worldwide with your physical Visa card.

## Private Bitcoin. Neo Bank. Your Keys, Your Coins. Private Bitcoin. Neo Bank. Your Keys, Your
## Coins.

Many features work without ID verification. Nuri does not store user data. Nuri is not a bank.

## Help in the app.

Get help directly in the app. Private chat with real people.

## Works with your AI in ChatGPT, Claude, Hermes & Co.

Connect Nuri to ChatGPT, Claude, and more. Let AI analyse your spending, prepare payments, and pay
for goods and services—with secure, permissioned access you control.

## SAVE IN BITCOIN. SPEND IT LIKE CASH.

Start with a self-custodial Bitcoin and Euro wallet. Unlock VISA, IBAN, and bank rails only when
daily life asks for them.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world

# [Discover the Power of Choice]
# 

A technology platform partner for utilities worldwide, that provides scalable, interoperable,
future-proof communications, and enables grid decisions while turning data into operational
intelligence.

[Explore Your AMI Roadmap][41]

### A Modern Platform for a Modern Grid

Trilliant enables utilities to gain real-time visibility and optimize performance across an
increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.
Move from data collection to real-time grid awareness.

[Read More][43]

### Applications and Intelligence

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

### The Grid Has Changed. Now AMI Must Respond.

Traditional AMI was designed for meter reading and billing.
Today's grid must support: Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), Rapid EV adoption, Increasing
reliability and resilience demands, and Real-time operational decision-making - All while moving
from beyond infrastructure to include intelligence.

Trilliant is dedicated to providing our valued customers with the power to choose only the solutions
you need that will ensure the most successful outcomes and endpoints.
Our [Power of Choice][45] device-independent platform means you have flexibility and
interoperability.

Watch our new video to learn how Trilliant is Powering Grid Intelligence with the Power of Choice.

# Acal BFi – Our approach to your success

*Consult. Design. Integrate.*

[How we work][41]

## Tomorrow’s technologies Explore the possibilities

As a leader in advanced solutions for tomorrow´s technologies, our primary goal is to enable
innovators to turn ideas and designs into exceptional products.

[Explore our technologies][42]

## Acal BFi Technology Centres

Where innovation meets expertise.

Underpinned by a consultative, design-oriented approach, our dedicated team of 150+ field engineers
and cutting-edge technology centres are at your disposal to create tailor-made solutions for even
the most intricate projects.

[Explore our Technology Centres][43]

## From a standard component to a full customised solution

We’re a leader in advanced solutions for *tomorrow’s technologies*

With a mission to empower innovators of electronic applications to turn ideas and designs into
exceptional products.

If you’re in search of a trusted technology solutions partner, your search ends here. Our extensive
knowledge, cutting-edge portfolio, and worldwide capabilities are at your service to bring the
future into reality.

### Communications & connectivity

Nowadays, the expectation for immediate access, anywhere, anytime has become the norm.

Whether you’re dealing with telecoms challenges, looking for the best networking solutions,
exploring unified communications, or diving into datacoms & broadcast technologies, our team are
ready to guide you.

[Explore the market][45]

### Consumer

From cutting-edge wearable tech and smart home devices to advanced entertainment systems and smart
white goods, this market offers a wealth of opportunities to create products that enhance everyday
life.

Explore the tools, trends, and insights that empower engineers to design and develop the next
generation of consumer electronics, ensuring a smarter, more connected future.

[Explore the market][46]

### Environmental

The environmental market encompasses a broad spectrum of industries and initiatives aimed at
mitigating environmental impact, conserving resources, and promoting sustainability.

From sensors and monitoring devices to advanced control and renewable energy systems, electronic
engineering is instrumental in designing and developing cutting-edge technologies that facilitate
environmental monitoring, resource management, renewable energy generation, and pollution control.

[Explore the market][47]

### Industrial & manufacturing

A market where the terrain is marked by rapid advancements and disruptive technologies, where
staying ahead of the curve isn’t just a challenge; it’s an imperative.

We are an end-to-end partner, dedicated to shaping solutions in the dynamic industrial market. We
offer a range of products, solutions, expertise, and technology centres to empower you throughout
your projects.

[Explore the market][48]

### Medical

This market presents a dynamic and ever-evolving landscape for electronic engineers. Innovative
solutions are enhancing patient care and safety, improving diagnosis, treatment plans, and remote
monitoring through real time data analytics.

Working with an experienced partner with the right capabilities makes all the difference in getting
designs to market

[Explore the market][49]

### Security

In a world where threats evolve as rapidly as technology, the role of electronic engineers has never
been more critical.

This dynamic market encompasses a broad spectrum of domains, including home security, industrial and
commercial security, cyber security, surveillance, early warning and detection systems, as well as
smart security and IoT solutions.

[Explore the market][50]

### Space & defence

The space and defence industry demands cutting-edge solutions in order to meet the complex
challenges of harsh environments, safety and security.

As this industry evolves, electronic engineers need to be at the forefront of innovation, driving
advancements in communications, navigation, propulsion, and defence systems to ensure superior
performance and safety in the skies and beyond.

[Explore the market][51]

### Transportation

Transforming transportation and mobility systems means developing solutions that enhance safety,
efficiency, and connectivity across various modes of transport. This demands a partner who can
rapidly support your needs for seamless, sustainable, accessible and affordable solutions.

As transportation continues to evolve, new designs are tasked with pushing the boundaries of
innovation to create smarter, more sustainable, and interconnected systems.

[Explore the market][52]

## Our Technology Centres blend industry experts and state-of-the-art facilities

*Where innovation meets expertise.* Solving the technical challenges of tomorrow

We understand that integrating multiple technologies into one application can sometimes be a
challenge.

Underpinned by a consultative, design-oriented approach, our dedicated team of 150+ field engineers
and cutting-edge Technology Centres are at your disposal to create tailor-made solutions for even
the most intricate projects.

[Explore our Technology Centres][53]
Our Technology Centres
BioPhotonics
Embedded Computing
Fibre Optics
Imaging Technology Centre
Interconnect and Cable Assembly
IoT and wireless
Magnetic Products
Power Supply

### [BioPhotonics][54]

#### With more than 15 years of experience in sales, installation, and service of BioPhotonics
#### systems, we can offer products and solutions tailored to your specific requirements.

The wide range of BioPhotonics cameras, lasers, LED light sources, spectrometers, optical
components, microscope systems, microscope accessories, and associated software enables us to
assemble almost any photonics or imaging solution.

[Explore our Technology Centre][55]

### [Embedded Computing][56]

#### The Embedded Computing Technology Centre drives advanced solutions, so you can deliver the
#### technologies of tomorrow – today.

Design customer driven systems, build prototypes and manufacture products to meet your distinct
needs. Many of the platform-based technologies that we offer were designed with customisation in
mind.

Our capabilities help us to offer solutions across all stages of your project. Whether your
requirements are standard, modified or highly customised, our experts support and identify your aims
and work to ensure that we provide a solution that fits.

[Explore our Technology Centre][57]

### [Fibre Optics][58]

#### The Fibre Optics Technology Centre allows our engineers to develop fibre optic solutions to
#### meet changing demands in a high-speed world.

With over 25 years of experience in fibre optics and application engineering for hardware and
components, we help to analyse and qualify to improve the stability and functionality of your
transceivers. Supporting our engineers with expertise and state of the art technology, the Fibre
Optics Technology Centre houses a number of our specialist capabilities.

[Explore our Technology Centre][59]

### [Imaging Technology Centre][60]

#### The Imaging Technology Centre is our dedicated hub for infrared and thermal imaging expertise,
#### supporting the design, integration, testing, and deployment of customised imaging solutions
#### across industrial, energy, transportation, aerospace, security, and specialist applications.

The Imaging Technology Centre is our dedicated hub for infrared and thermal imaging expertise,
supporting the design, integration, testing, and deployment of customised imaging solutions across
industrial, energy, transportation, aerospace, security, and specialist applications.

By combining deep technical knowledge with specialist facilities and equipment, our team supports
customers developing everything from standard infrared camera integrations to fully bespoke imaging
systems.

[Explore our Technology Centre][61]

### [Interconnect and Cable Assembly][62]

#### The capabilities and expertise housed within the Interconnect and Cable Assembly Technology
#### Centre ensure that our team can support you every step of the way.

Providing and customising bespoke specialist fibre and cables including hybrids with custom
connectors, the Technology Centre is on hand to support with design, assembly, testing and approvals
for your customised solutions.

[Explore our Technology Centre][63]

### [IoT and wireless][64]

#### The IoT and Wireless Technology Centre has the ability to support complex discrete component
#### design-in from a bespoke System on Chip (SoC), right through to fully integrated modules that
#### are certified and application ready.

Creating custom solutions that add connectivity to an application requires specialist expertise and
capabilities. Our team of wireless technology hardware design and software application engineers
cover RF, wireless, cellular and many more state-of-the-art technologies. Together they have
extensive individual and collective experience of developing customised solutions, ensuring we can
bring your concept to life.

[Explore our Technology Centre][65]

### [Magnetic Products][66]

#### The Magnetic Products Technology Centre is at the forefront of our solution led approach for
#### applications that require customised cores and components, driving our commitment to developing
#### an enhanced technological future together.

Over the last 25 years, we have grown our expertise in the design-led customisation of magnetic
components. With the largest team of technical support specialists, the Magnetic Products Technology
Centre is at the forefront of magnetic based technological advancements. Our team design and
manufacture magnetic components including transformers, inductors, and even cores to meet the
technical and commercial aspects of your project, whether you are in design or production.

[Explore our Technology Centre][67]

### [Power Supply][68]

#### The extensive breadth of experience held by our in-house design industrial power engineers
#### ensures that we have the expertise to develop customised industrial power supply solutions,
#### ranging from 1W to 25kW for a wide range of applications.

## A Complete, Plug-and-Play Smart Metering Ecosystem

As pioneers in smart metering, we proudly offer one of the few truly all-encompassing solutions. Our
plug-and-play ecosystem integrates Smart Meters, Communication Networks, Head End Systems, and Meter
Data Management for seamless functionality. This complete suite works harmoniously to support
efficient energy management.
[ Explore Our Solutions ][52]

## Who We Are?

## We pioneer unique solutions for the smart grid ecosystem

Our journey started with a mission: to create SMART and efficient utility solutions.Today, we stand
out by offering comprehensive solutions, combining high-end metering, advanced communication,
cutting-edge software, and consulting.

## Digi2Smart

Adya’s Digi2Smart is a solution that transforms traditional digital electricity meters into advanced
smart meters. This patented, plug-and-play technology significantly reduces capital expenditure by
eliminating the need for meter replacements, cutting costs by half. By simply plugging the
Digi2Smart module into an existing digital meter, utilities can avoid power disruptions and lengthy
deployment cycles, enabling faster transitions across millions of meters.

The environmental benefits are equally impactful, as Digi2Smart prevents e-waste by repurposing
existing meters, reducing the ecological footprint of meter replacements. Tailored for India’s scale
and price-sensitive market, Digi2Smart is designed to ensure rapid adoption without compromising
affordability. Adya’s innovative solution is a leap forward in sustainable and efficient energy
management.

## Digi2Smart

Adya’s Digi2Smart is a solution that transforms traditional digital electricity meters into advanced
smart meters. This patented, plug-and-play technology significantly reduces capital expenditure by
eliminating the need for meter replacements, cutting costs by half. By simply plugging the
Digi2Smart module into an existing digital meter, utilities can avoid power disruptions and lengthy
deployment cycles, enabling faster transitions across millions of meters.

The environmental benefits are equally impactful, as Digi2Smart prevents e-waste by repurposing
existing meters, reducing the ecological footprint of meter replacements. Tailored for India’s scale
and price-sensitive market, Digi2Smart is designed to ensure rapid adoption without compromising
affordability. Adya’s innovative solution is a leap forward in sustainable and efficient energy
management.

reliable 811 response with precise line marking using advanced GPR technology.

Mobile leak detection services keep active worksites safe. Our trained teams monitor for gas leaks
in real-time, preventing hazards and ensuring compliance throughout your project.

Advanced AMR technology delivers accurate data collection with flexible manual and automated
options. Our trained, experienced teams provide consistent, reliable reads that reduce billing
errors and improve operational efficiency.

every phase from route analysis to optimization, helping you maximize your smart meter investment
and modernize your operations.

emergency response. Advanced RMLD technology and digital documentation help you meet Public Service
Commission requirements and maintain safety standards.

High-accuracy contract meter reading with 99.5% route completion rates. Flexible partnerships
tailored to your utility’s needs, combining manual precision with automated efficiency for
residential, commercial, and industrial accounts.

management, and billing support. We handle all the details so you can focus on your core operations

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

Is any maintenance required for EV charging stations?

Yes, maintenance is required for electric cars’ charging stations to ensure proper and safe
operation and reduce downtime. [Ways of maintaining EV charge stations][25] include cleaning
connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance. 

What support services do you offer?

Blink provides 24/7 customer support through multiple channels to address any questions. We also
install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality. 

Additional services include over-the-air software updates and training resources for customers and
partners. Blink aims to offer a reliable EV charging experience with around-the-clock assistance.

Blink offers [turnkey EV charging services][26], including installation, maintenance, and support,
to keep your charging stations running smoothly for longer.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

Is any maintenance required for EV charging stations?

Yes, maintenance is required for electric cars’ charging stations to ensure proper and safe
operation and reduce downtime. [Ways of maintaining EV charge stations][25] include cleaning
connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance. 

What support services do you offer?

Blink provides 24/7 customer support through multiple channels to address any questions. We also
install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality. 

Additional services include over-the-air software updates and training resources for customers and
partners. Blink aims to offer a reliable EV charging experience with around-the-clock assistance.

Blink offers [turnkey EV charging services][26], including installation, maintenance, and support,
to keep your charging stations running smoothly for longer.

## Ready to start designing your ideal EV Charging solution?

Learn how to use EV charging stations to attract new customers and increase duration and frequency
of visits at your business.

[Get in Touch][27]

## Company Overview

Yueqing Xingyang Electronic Co., Ltd. (CNXY for short) is an enterprise specialized in the design,
production and sale of electric equipment. Our company has an office located in the largest
manufacturing base of electric equipment - Wenzhou, which is called "the Electric Equipment Capital
of China". CNXY has five specialized branches and over 300 specialized cooperative partners. CNXY,
an ISO9001 certified enterprise, has modern production lines and high quality control equipment,
with scientific administration, professional engineers, well trained teams and technicians and
skilled workers. Now CNXY has five design and production bases in Hong Kong, Taiwan area, Singapore,
Turkey and Wenzhou (China Mainland) respectively, 28 sales organizations around the world and more
than 50 holding member enterprises. CNXY products include low-voltage apparatuses, welding
equipment, instruments and meters, photoelectron products, electrical products for construction,
automobile apparatus and industrial automatic equipment. Our products are sold to more than 100
countries and regions. All the export products have passed CE certification and some products have
passed several international certifications like RoHS, TUV, UL, KEMA, SIRIM and so on. Your Success,

## Company Overview

Yueqing Xingyang Electronic Co., Ltd. (CNXY for short) is an enterprise specialized in the design,
production and sale of electric equipment. Our company has an office located in the largest
manufacturing base of electric equipment - Wenzhou, which is called "the Electric Equipment Capital
of China". CNXY has five specialized branches and over 300 specialized cooperative partners. CNXY,
an ISO9001 certified enterprise, has modern production lines and high quality control equipment,
with scientific administration, professional engineers, well trained teams and technicians and
skilled workers. Now CNXY has five design and production bases in Hong Kong, Taiwan area, Singapore,
Turkey and Wenzhou (China Mainland) respectively, 28 sales organizations around the world and more
than 50 holding member enterprises. CNXY products include low-voltage apparatuses, welding
equipment, instruments and meters, photoelectron products, electrical products for construction,

## Innovation

With a constantly-expanding open hub with dedicated resources, Conlog drives, develops & incubates
ideas from all corners of our business, empowering us to stay ahead of industry trends & disrupt the
markets through innovation.

## Sustainability

Our sustainability strategy is aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, focusing on
people, planet & prosperity.

## Growth

We are committed to growth & improvement, expanding our product range, pursuing global expansion,
and developing deeper customer understanding.

# World leaders in smart metering solutions

200+ patents & trademarks | Presence in 58+ countries | A global footprint of 17+ million smart
meters | Servicing 90+ utilities & 50+ million households

Backed by decades of experience, innovation and expertise, Conlog is a world leader in smart
metering solutions. With a global network of more than 17 million meters spanning over 58 countries,
we have established ourselves as the gold standard of smart metering technology.

Our smart meters assist our customers with utility management, revenue enhancement, load management
and demand management, focusing on big data analytics and smart grid solutions.

As a proudly South African black industrialist company with local shareholders, we hold our B-BBEE
Level 1 certification. Our electrical meters and water meters are manufactured using 98% and 85%
local materials respectively, contributing to the economic upliftment of our country.

## Innovation

With a constantly-expanding open hub with dedicated resources, Conlog drives, develops & incubates
ideas from all corners of our business, empowering us to stay ahead of industry trends & disrupt the
markets through innovation.

## Sustainability

Our sustainability strategy is aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, focusing on
people, planet & prosperity.

## Growth

We are committed to growth & improvement, expanding our product range, pursuing global expansion,
and developing deeper customer understanding.

# World leaders in smart metering solutions

200+ patents & trademarks | Presence in 58+ countries | A global footprint of 17+ million smart
meters | Servicing 90+ utilities & 50+ million households

Backed by decades of experience, innovation and expertise, Conlog is a world leader in smart
metering solutions. With a global network of more than 17 million meters spanning over 58 countries,
we have established ourselves as the gold standard of smart metering technology.

Our smart meters assist our customers with utility management, revenue enhancement, load management
and demand management, focusing on big data analytics and smart grid solutions.

As a proudly South African black industrialist company with local shareholders, we hold our B-BBEE
Level 1 certification. Our electrical meters and water meters are manufactured using 98% and 85%
local materials respectively, contributing to the economic upliftment of our country.

## Blue Jay Categories

Electrical metering, Automatic protection relay like insulation monitoring relay, etc.
Choose the solutions you need with innovative technologies & high standard products and ODM/OEM
services.

### [Branch Circuit Metering][56]

### [Branch Circuit Metering][57]

Ideal multi-circuit power metering solutions for commercial new and retrofit projects. One
multi-channel meter can replace multiple ordinary meters. Any metering combinations of four-channel,
six-channel, and eight-channel are possible allowing you to provide flexibility with installations
of electrical metering systems.
[Learn More][58]

### [Multifunctional Panel Metering][59]

### [Multifunctional Panel Metering][60]

Blue Jay's panel or din rail mounted multifunction meters are ideal for monitoring electrical
feeders or busbars in 600V and below systems. These advanced meters provide comprehensive data on
energy consumption, waveform capture, harmonics, and power quality, enabling users to optimize
energy efficiency in buildings, automation, and power distribution networks.
[Learn More][61]

### [DC Metering Solution][62]

### [DC Metering Solution][63]

Ideal DC metering solutions for EV charging stations, solar panels wind turbines, light rail
transit, Data centers, energy storage and other renewable energy systems. With OEM & ODM service,
our DC versatile and accurate metering solutions can meet a variety of DC project.
[Learn More][64]

### [AC DC Insulation Monitoring Device][65]

### [AC DC Insulation Monitoring Device][66]

Comprehensive insulation monitoring relays for electrical safety while charging or driving. Our AC
or DC insulation monitoring devices are widely used to monitor the insulation in electrical
vehicles, EV charging stations, railways, energy storage systems, medical systems, etc.
[Learn More][67]

### [ARC Flash Protection][68]

### [ARC Flash Protection][69]

An innovative solution for LV and MV arc flash protection. High-speed response to arc faults with
arc flash and overcurrent detection. 3-channel, 4-channel, 48-channel arc flash sensor options.
[Learn More][70]

### [Motor Protection][71]

### [Motor Protection][72]

Blue Jay motor protection solutions combine a full range of protection functions including overload,
thermal, phase loss, overcurrent, earth fault, etc. Our multifunctional motor protection relay is
the most competitive and cost-effective solution for LV asynchronous motors, synchronous motors,
pumps, etc.
[Learn More][73]
WHO WE ARE

## Focus on Electrical & Automation

Chongqing Blue Jay Technology Co., Ltd. (Blue Jay or Cqbluejay) is your professional energy metering
& protection relay factory in China. With over 10 years of professional experience, Blue Jay
specializes in the development, manufacturing, and sales of high-quality power energy meters and
power automation protection relays. We also provide customized metering and power grid protection
solutions for OEM/ODM customers.
[ Learn More ][74]

[

### Producto 100% argentino

][40]

Los productos de DISCAR son íntegramente desarrollados y producidos en la Argentina, cumpliendo con
normas y estándares internacionales, con procesos certificados bajo norma ISO 9001-2015. Esto
significa garantía de continuidad, soporte y evolución permanente sin disrupciones.

[

### Soporte 24/7

][41]

El soporte preventa y posventa es un elemento distintivo de nuestra Empresa y a la vez es la
garantía del éxito de todas las instalaciones en las que DISCAR es el partner tecnológico de smart
metering. Asesoramos a nuestros clientes para elegir la mejor opción para cada caso, y los apoyamos
durante el despliegue y en la integración con sus sistemas.

[

### Stock Permanente

][42]

Conocemos las necesidades de nuestros clientes, y muchas veces es necesario brindar respuesta
inmediata a una necesidad que implique proveer de manera inmediata. Para ello, en DISCAR contamos
con stock permanente de todos los modelos de medidores. No dependemos de las limitaciones y los
caprichos de la importación de productos terminados.

[

### Aseguramos la inversión

][43]

Asegurar la inversión es clave: cuando un producto es sorpresivamente discontinuado el cliente puede
perder la totalidad de su inversión aún antes de haber cumplido su ciclo de recupero de la
inversión. Los productos de DISCAR aseguran continuidad, soporte y retro-compatibilidad a nivel de
software, para asegurar a nuestros clientes el recupero de su inversión.

## Nuestras Soluciones

#### Contamos con soluciones específicas para cada caso de aplicación: entornos residenciales,
#### entornos rurales, monitoreo de subestaciones, alumbrado público y la innovadora solución con
#### conectividad WiFi !

  ][46]
* [
  
  ### Medidores Prepagos y Pospagos con conectividad WiFi
  
  ][47]
* [
  
  ### Medidores / Controladores de Alumbrado Público
  
  ][48]

## Nuestros Clientes

#### Contamos con una amplia experiencia, avalada por más de 200 distribuidoras de energía eléctrica
#### que ya cuentan con nuestro sistema.

### Producto 100% argentino

][40]

Los productos de DISCAR son íntegramente desarrollados y producidos en la Argentina, cumpliendo con
normas y estándares internacionales, con procesos certificados bajo norma ISO 9001-2015. Esto
significa garantía de continuidad, soporte y evolución permanente sin disrupciones.

[

### Soporte 24/7

][41]

El soporte preventa y posventa es un elemento distintivo de nuestra Empresa y a la vez es la
garantía del éxito de todas las instalaciones en las que DISCAR es el partner tecnológico de smart
metering. Asesoramos a nuestros clientes para elegir la mejor opción para cada caso, y los apoyamos
durante el despliegue y en la integración con sus sistemas.

[

### Stock Permanente

][42]

Conocemos las necesidades de nuestros clientes, y muchas veces es necesario brindar respuesta
inmediata a una necesidad que implique proveer de manera inmediata. Para ello, en DISCAR contamos
con stock permanente de todos los modelos de medidores. No dependemos de las limitaciones y los
caprichos de la importación de productos terminados.

[

### Aseguramos la inversión

][43]

Asegurar la inversión es clave: cuando un producto es sorpresivamente discontinuado el cliente puede
perder la totalidad de su inversión aún antes de haber cumplido su ciclo de recupero de la
inversión. Los productos de DISCAR aseguran continuidad, soporte y retro-compatibilidad a nivel de
software, para asegurar a nuestros clientes el recupero de su inversión.

Enjoy peace of mind with a fixed tariff that protects you from price rises

#### Fix today!

As an EDF customer, refer your friends to us and you'll both get £50 off your energy bill if your
friend joins EDF. You can track all of your referrals in MyAccount.

tariffs][16] that use electricity when its cheapest, and offer [low-carbon products][17] installed
by Which? trusted experts. And with ongoing improvements in service, our commitment to [vulnerable

or choose the cap-priced standard variable tariff.  

Compare cap prices against our tariffs - now, and in the future! 

Making energy easier for everyone.

imports and help prevent future price rises.

system**][22] **and generate **[**zero carbon electricity**][23].

results][25].

Learn more about our [charity partnership][28].

Our customer service is rated excellent on [Trustpilot][29]

## Powering Transformation

like no other

World is advancing rapidly and the power sector is one of the most vital pillars that is making it
possible. India is no exception. The Indian Government has undertaken various programmes and
initiatives to improve operational efficiency and financial sustainability of utilities by providing
result-linked financial assistance. With the help of these schemes, utilities will have increased
access to funds for deploying Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) and Smart Meters. ...This will
help in modernization of the grid as well as loss reduction. The progressive measures by the policy
makers have no doubt accelerated power sector development in India. It is no different globally.
Governments across the globe have earmarked funding for grid modernisation and are engaged in
developing and enacting policies that support smart technologies including AMI and smart metering.
As pioneers in Electronic Energy Meters in India and with over 80+ million meters installed, Genus
has been at the forefront of metering since its inception in 1995. Currently Genus is among the
largest players in electricity metering solutions industry in India, with 27% (appx) market share
and is poised to scale new heights both locally and globally.
Armed with increased installed capacity of meters, Genus is looking at the future with lots of
promise and potential to make a powerful impact on the utility providers around the world.

## Powering Transformation

like no other

World is advancing rapidly and the power sector is one of the most vital pillars that is making it
possible. India is no exception. The Indian Government has undertaken various programmes and
initiatives to improve operational efficiency and financial sustainability of utilities by providing
result-linked financial assistance. With the help of these schemes, utilities will have increased
access to funds for deploying Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) and Smart Meters. ...This will
help in modernization of the grid as well as loss reduction. The progressive measures by the policy
makers have no doubt accelerated power sector development in India. It is no different globally.
Governments across the globe have earmarked funding for grid modernisation and are engaged in
developing and enacting policies that support smart technologies including AMI and smart metering.
As pioneers in Electronic Energy Meters in India and with over 80+ million meters installed, Genus
has been at the forefront of metering since its inception in 1995. Currently Genus is among the
largest players in electricity metering solutions industry in India, with 27% (appx) market share
and is poised to scale new heights both locally and globally.
Armed with increased installed capacity of meters, Genus is looking at the future with lots of
promise and potential to make a powerful impact on the utility providers around the world.

# Geospace Technologies

## [Smart Water][90]

Our smart water products enable the global smart water utility and asset protection markets with
robust water-proof connectors and cloud-based remote shut-off valves. We serve utility and water
management districts, commercial and multi-family residential asset managers, and those designing
the smart water management systems of the future.

[Learn More][91]

## Geospace Technologies

## [Energy Solutions][92]

Our energy solutions technologies deliver actionable information for energy exploration and mitigate
risk in the new energy economy. Our leading seismic sensing technologies serve customers with
exploration products, reservoir monitoring, and energy transition applications.

[Learn More][93]

## Geospace Technologies

## [Intelligent Industrial][94]

Our Intelligent Industrial offerings harness technology pedigree with our deep-sensing capability to
deliver empowering, informative, and efficient tools to our global customers. Our sensing
technologies reach well beyond our roots in energy to improve national and homeland security and
surveillance.

[Learn More][95]

## Our Purpose

Geospace partners with customers to solve their toughest challenges, delivering innovative solutions
and sustainable long-term value to our key stakeholders.

[Learn More][96]
[Learn More][97]
[Learn More][98]

## Discover Geospace

Learn more about what differentiates Geospace from other players in energy exploration, security and
surveillance, and wider industrial application fields.

## 15-year experience in providing smart water meters using its embedded ultrasonic technology

Since 2010 INTEGRA Metering Ultrasonic stands for metering technology based on its own technology,
high quality standards, and a wide range of water meters, from district to domestic, for potable
water, C&I and irrigation segments

## Committed to deliver quality products

We build on our over 15-years experience to deliver customized water meters to utilities,
municipalities, operators, distributors and partners. Our products feature full certification for
measurement instrument directives (e.g. MID) and international potable water regulations (e.g. ACS,
WRAS, SVGW, DVGW, KTW, BELGAQUA).

## Environmental protection

Protecting the environment is part of our identity. We take particular attention to comply with
environmental law and guidelines, and use a large range of indicators to assess our environmental
performance. By providing smart water meters we help water conservation and sustainable water use,
enabling accurate measurement of water usage, and encouraging consumers to use water more
responsibly

## Smart water meters for efficient billing and reduce non-revenue water

INTEGRA Metering Ultrasonic offers you a complete portfolio of smart metering solutions as well as
high-quality and reliable utility water meters for the potable, residential, network, and irrigation
applications. All water meters feature full certification for measurement instrument directives
(e.g. MID) and international potable water regulations (e.g. SVGW, KTW, WRAS, ACS).

## 15-year experience in providing smart water meters using its embedded ultrasonic technology

Since 2010 INTEGRA Metering Ultrasonic stands for metering technology based on its own technology,
high quality standards, and a wide range of water meters, from district to domestic, for potable
water, C&I and irrigation segments

## Committed to deliver quality products

We build on our over 15-years experience to deliver customized water meters to utilities,
municipalities, operators, distributors and partners. Our products feature full certification for
measurement instrument directives (e.g. MID) and international potable water regulations (e.g. ACS,
WRAS, SVGW, DVGW, KTW, BELGAQUA).

## Environmental protection

Protecting the environment is part of our identity. We take particular attention to comply with
environmental law and guidelines, and use a large range of indicators to assess our environmental
performance. By providing smart water meters we help water conservation and sustainable water use,
enabling accurate measurement of water usage, and encouraging consumers to use water more
responsibly

applications. All water meters feature full certification for measurement instrument directives
(e.g. MID) and international potable water regulations (e.g. SVGW, KTW, WRAS, ACS).

Integra Metering Systems is a company specializing in the supply of electric, water, gas and heat
meters,offers advanced reading services for electricity. Since 2008, it has collaborated with Itron,
offering innovative solutions for energy consumption monitoring and efficient resource management.
Integra is also active in the renewable energy sector, providing state-of-the-art devices for
sustainable and smart energy use.

Find out more

[Electricity][20]

[Water and Heat][21]

[Gas][22]

## **SERVICES**

## Remote reading

We offer a remote reading service for electric meters, available in SaaS and on-premise modes.
Receive readings at customized intervals for accurate and consistent monitoring. Optimize energy
management and reduce operational costs.

Find out more

## UTF Certificate

We offer comprehensive UTF certification services for electricity meters, ensuring compliance with
the measurement standards required by fiscal regulations.We undertake periodic verification and
calibration, ensuring that your meters operate accurately and reliably.

# INESH SMART ENERGY

**INESH** an innovative technology solution provider in energy sector. Our Smart product range in
metering, communication and software can be the right fit for a complete Smart Grid ECO Systerm.  A
Renowned R&D Design house and manufacturer of smart meter, smart grid prodcuts and Telecom Energy
management products. Our Innovative patented first of its kind Smarte™ is a golden platter solution
for the meter manufacturers who wish to be and (AMI) smart meter manufacturer.

**INESH’s** powerful **Smarte****™** smart metering system on module enables the meter manufacturers
and utilities to manufacture and deploy truly interoperable highly secure smart meter and smart grid
at an ease and in shortest possible time. Inesh’s IPV6 technology platform connects homes,
businesses and communities smarter, better and faster.

Inesh Smart Energy (P) LTD is an Indian incorporation of a Global venture, incorported in Chennai to
transfer the technology advantage to Indian Smart grid oppurtunity and Energy management in Utility
and Telecom sectors.

Inesh offers a high quality energy solution and and products in the utility, telecom and renewable
energy markets. INESH’s modular approach and open standard flexibile and plug play communciation
architecutre enables the fastest smart grid rollout for the utilites and smart meter providers.

## Wasserversorgung

Im Wasserbereich bietet INTEGRA Metering ein komplettes Portfolio an intelligenten Messlösungen
sowie qualitativ hochwertige und zuverlässige Brauchwasserzähler für die Bereiche Trinkwasser,
Haushalte, Netzwerk und Bewässerung an. Alle Wasserzähler verfügen über eine vollständige
Zertifizierung nach Messgeräterichtlinien (z.B. MID) und lokalen und internationalen
Trinkwasserverordnungen (z.B. SVGW, KTW, WRAS, ACS).

[ Wasserversorgung entdecken ][32]

## Thermische Energie

Im Bereich der thermischen Energie bietet INTEGRA Metering eine grosse Auswahl an Rechenwerken,
Durchflusszählern und Temperaturfühlern für Heiz- und Kühlanwendungen in Industrie-, Gewerbe- und
Wohngebäuden sowie in der Nah- und Fernwärmeversorgung an. INTEGRA Metering kombiniert sein
Premium-Produktangebot mit den erforderlichen Kommunikationstechnologien und
Top-Engineering-Dienstleistungen, um die besten Messlösungen und Systemintegration zu gewährleisten.

[ Thermische Energie entdecken ][33]

## Systeme & Softwares

Darüber hinaus unterstützt INTEGRA Metering seine Kunden und Geschäftspartner mit einem kompletten
Portfolio an Systemen und Dienstleistungen, von Kommunikationsmodulen und Software bis hin zum
Datenmanagement und zur Integration mit Steuerungs- und Analysesystemen sowie dem Datenschutz.

[ Systeme & Softwares entdecken ][34]

## Services

In der Schweiz und in Deutschland begleiten wir Sie mit einem umfassenden Serviceangebot –
kompetent, verständlich und nah an Ihren Bedürfnissen.

Ob Installation, regelmässige Prüfung oder individuelle Beratung: Wir kennen Ihre Anforderungen und
bieten Ihnen die passende Lösung – von Anfang an bis zum laufenden Betrieb.

Als staatlich anerkannte Eichprüfstelle kalibrieren wir Ihre Energie- und Wassermessgeräte – mit
Fokus auf Kälte und Wärme – und stellen sicher, dass Ihre Produkte den gesetzlichen Schweizer
Anforderungen entsprechen.

[ Services entdecken ][35]

Bei INTEGRA Metering erwarten Sie spannende Herausforderungen, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und ein
inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld. Machen Sie den nächsten Karriereschritt bei uns – und gestalten Sie
eine nachhaltige Zukunft!

## Wasserversorgung

Im Wasserbereich bietet INTEGRA Metering ein komplettes Portfolio an intelligenten Messlösungen
sowie qualitativ hochwertige und zuverlässige Brauchwasserzähler für die Bereiche Trinkwasser,
Haushalte, Netzwerk und Bewässerung an. Alle Wasserzähler verfügen über eine vollständige
Zertifizierung nach Messgeräterichtlinien (z.B. MID) und lokalen und internationalen
Trinkwasserverordnungen (z.B. SVGW, KTW, WRAS, ACS).

[ Wasserversorgung entdecken ][32]

## Thermische Energie

Im Bereich der thermischen Energie bietet INTEGRA Metering eine grosse Auswahl an Rechenwerken,
Durchflusszählern und Temperaturfühlern für Heiz- und Kühlanwendungen in Industrie-, Gewerbe- und
Wohngebäuden sowie in der Nah- und Fernwärmeversorgung an. INTEGRA Metering kombiniert sein
Premium-Produktangebot mit den erforderlichen Kommunikationstechnologien und
Top-Engineering-Dienstleistungen, um die besten Messlösungen und Systemintegration zu gewährleisten.

[ Thermische Energie entdecken ][33]

## Systeme & Softwares

Darüber hinaus unterstützt INTEGRA Metering seine Kunden und Geschäftspartner mit einem kompletten
Portfolio an Systemen und Dienstleistungen, von Kommunikationsmodulen und Software bis hin zum
Datenmanagement und zur Integration mit Steuerungs- und Analysesystemen sowie dem Datenschutz.

[ Systeme & Softwares entdecken ][34]

## Services

In der Schweiz und in Deutschland begleiten wir Sie mit einem umfassenden Serviceangebot –
kompetent, verständlich und nah an Ihren Bedürfnissen.

Ob Installation, regelmässige Prüfung oder individuelle Beratung: Wir kennen Ihre Anforderungen und
bieten Ihnen die passende Lösung – von Anfang an bis zum laufenden Betrieb.

Als staatlich anerkannte Eichprüfstelle kalibrieren wir Ihre Energie- und Wassermessgeräte – mit
Fokus auf Kälte und Wärme – und stellen sicher, dass Ihre Produkte den gesetzlichen Schweizer
Anforderungen entsprechen.

##### YouSolar, Inc.

Arnold Leitner, President and CEO When YouSolar needed a quick and easy way to monitor its power
systems installed at different customer locations, we turned to KaaIoT. The data flow is reliable,
and the chart options make it easy to see what is happening at our customers.
[testimonial-image]

##### ATMESYS

Piotr Grzymski, Chief Executive Officer With the KaaloT team's assistance we achieved our goals
within a tight timeline. They influenced us in a positive way and made advantageous changes to the
platform which allowed us to implement updates for our smart weather station.
[testimonial-image]

##### ROBOTHON

Peter So, Al Researcher,IoT and robotics engineer We were happy to use Kaa's platform for our
worldwide Robothon Grand Challenge Competition, which went digital this year, and share our passion
for robotics and building a better, greener environment for all.
[testimonial-image]

##### NET4.10

Dave Locke, Chief Technology Officer Kaa is at the core of many of our solutions. We have been
consistently impressed with the technology and with the skill of KaaloT's engineers who have
assisted the development of our solutions. Their willingness to take on board new ideas and
requirements and then deliver them in a timely manner has made Kaa a more rounded and valuable
technology for our solutions to be based on.
[testimonial-image]

##### COMPACSA

IoT services company The KaaloT team uses efficient communication to make sure all of our project
milestones are met. With rapid and functional platform updates, we were able to deploy our system of
medical refrigerators quickly without having to use additional resources.
[testimonial-image]

##### PRIVATE COMPANY

Peyman Yousefi I developed an loT hardware for controlling and monitoring many huge dewatering pumps
all around the country. The problem was I had only one week to implement an online dashboard. After
a lot of research, I chose Kaa over other platforms which is one of my best decisions in life! There
are many great things about Kaa such as simplicity and being ready to use without writing a single
code. The documentation was great and straight which is very important, and the support was
phenomenal. You can even  design your own widgets or design your custom frontend and never worry
about the backend using the APIs. I strongly suggest Kaa to all you guys out there.
[testimonial-image]

##### SUNCULTURE

Tom Vranken, Director of Software Powered by KaaloT, our smart solar-powered irrigation system was
provided to our clients to track their equipment performance and green energy production. We are
delighted to take that step to both empower our customers as well as further use the device data for
proactive outreach and remote support. SunCulture and Kaa teams were pushing boundaries together -
talented Kaa engineers handled platform configuration and implemented several new to the platform
features.
[testimonial-image]

##### ENDOKS

Erman Terciyanli, Chief Executive Officer At Endoks, we create solutions for power quality,
distribution management systems and energy efficiency. As a part of our new monitoring solution, we
decided to support several loT platforms including Kaa-hosted loT platform for device management and
monitoring tasks. The platform turned out to be very flexible with a wide range of useful features,
which we used to set up all the functionality that we needed. The Kaa engineering team was very
friendly and supportive. They gave us a great intro to the platform and followed us along the way,
making sure we learned all the nuts and bolts of the technology. It has been a real pleasure to work
with the Kaa team.
[testimonial-image]

##### RADIX ELECTROSYSTEMS

Raosaheb Patil, Automation Manager Kaa Cloud loT solution has delivered our process control
instrumentation project goals. Thanks to them, our project has greatly increased its scalability.
The dedicated team was always reachable in Slack and was helpful and proficient. Our goal was to
deploy quickly and in a sustainable way because we could detect all the issues early.

## Frequently Asked

## Questions

What is advanced metering infrastructure and how does it work?
[Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI)][56] is an integrated system that brings together [smart
meters][57], communication networks, and data management software to enable seamless, two-way
communication between utilities and consumers.

Kimbal’s AMI solution is designed to make energy management simpler and more efficient for
utilities. It combines Kushal smart meters, [ImGATI in-meter gateway][58], Vayu RF-Mesh
communication infrastructure, Vaani Head-End System (HES), and cellular communication via [Network
Interface Cards (NIC)][59]. Together, these components help utilities track energy consumption in
real time, remotely connect and disconnect supply, and automate billing, without requiring physical
meter reading.
What variants of smart meters does Kimbal manufacture?
Kimbal offers a comprehensive range of smart meters designed to meet the needs of residential,
commercial, and utility applications. This includes single-phase, three-phase, LTCT, HT, feeder, and
distribution transformer (DT) meters.

All [Kimbal smart meters][60] are IS 16444-compliant, ensuring dependable performance across diverse
geographical conditions and use cases. Built with advanced capabilities such as real-time
monitoring, accurate billing, remote communication, and tamper detection, these meters help
utilities operate more efficiently while giving consumers better visibility into their energy usage.
With a product defect rate below 0.5%, the smart meters are designed for reliability and long-term
performance, making them a trusted choice for smart metering deploy

## Frequently Asked

## Questions

What is advanced metering infrastructure and how does it work?
[Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI)][56] is an integrated system that brings together [smart
meters][57], communication networks, and data management software to enable seamless, two-way
communication between utilities and consumers.

Kimbal’s AMI solution is designed to make energy management simpler and more efficient for
utilities. It combines Kushal smart meters, [ImGATI in-meter gateway][58], Vayu RF-Mesh
communication infrastructure, Vaani Head-End System (HES), and cellular communication via [Network
Interface Cards (NIC)][59]. Together, these components help utilities track energy consumption in
real time, remotely connect and disconnect supply, and automate billing, without requiring physical
meter reading.
What variants of smart meters does Kimbal manufacture?
Kimbal offers a comprehensive range of smart meters designed to meet the needs of residential,
commercial, and utility applications. This includes single-phase, three-phase, LTCT, HT, feeder, and
distribution transformer (DT) meters.

All [Kimbal smart meters][60] are IS 16444-compliant, ensuring dependable performance across diverse
geographical conditions and use cases. Built with advanced capabilities such as real-time
monitoring, accurate billing, remote communication, and tamper detection, these meters help
utilities operate more efficiently while giving consumers better visibility into their energy usage.
With a product defect rate below 0.5%, the smart meters are designed for reliability and long-term
performance, making them a trusted choice for smart metering deployments across India.
What is a Head-End-System and what does Kimbal Vaani HES offer?
A Head-End System (HES) is the central platform that communicates with smart meters to collects
meter data and sends commands across the smart metering network.

[Vaani is Kimbal’s enterprise-grade Head-End System][61] designed to make smart metering operations
easier and more efficient. Vaani’s open architecture ensures seamless interoperability with smart
meters from multiple OEMs, giving utilities greater flexibility and control.

Vaani also provides real-time insights, intelligent automation, reliable command execution, and zero
data loss, helping utilities manage their networks with confidence. Its architecture scales
seamlessly to support growing deployments. With an open and flexible design, Vaani also integrates
easily with Meter Data Management (MDM) systems, making it a future-ready solution for utilities of
any size.
What communication technology does Kimbal use for AMI connectivity?
Kimbal’s primary connectivity solution is its KMesh. KMesh is a Made-in-India mesh network designed
to deliver reliable communication even in challenging environments. It enables fast network
convergence, robust multi-hop data routing, and multi-layered encryption, ensuring secure and
consistent data transfer across the smart metering network.

Kimbal also offers a Cellular 4G communication module for areas that require wider coverage. With
dual-SIM support, seamless network switching, and 2G fallback, it helps maintain uninterrupted
connectivity, even in locations where network availability may be intermittent or inconsistent.
What is a Network Interface Card (NIC) and why does it matter?
A [Network Interface Card (NIC)][62] is the communication module in a smart meter that enables it to
connect to the wider AMI network. In simple terms, it acts as the bridge between the meter and the
utility’s system, enabling seamless data transfer.

Kimbal’s NIC supports both RF-Mesh (NAN) and Cellular 4G communication, so meters can reliably
connect across different locations and network conditions. With a NIC, every meter, whether in dense
urban areas or a remote location, can securely send consumption data to the Head-End System in real
time. This enables better visibility and smarter energy management decisions.
What is Kimbal’s AI-enabled Meter Reading App Samaksha?
[Samaksha is Kimbal’s AI-powered meter reading application][63] designed to make meter reading
faster, more accurate, and cost-effective. The AI-enabled app can accurately read meter displays
across different lighting and display conditions, helping reduce manual errors and improve
efficiency.

Samaksha is particularly useful for utilities that still operate legacy meters and need a practical
bridge before transitioning to full smart meter deployments. By simplifying meter reading and
reducing operational costs, Samaksha helps utilities take their first step toward smarter energy
management.
Are Kimbal’s product range compliant with India’s RDSS and government smart metering mandates?
Yes, Kimbal’s smart meters are IS 16444-compliant and BIS-approved, ensuring they meet regulatory
and performance standards. The meters are manufactured in a BIS-approved facility and supported by
an in-house NABL-accredited testing laboratory, ensuring quality and reliability at every stage of
the manufacturing process.

Kimbal is the key industry partner in India’s Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS). With more
than 12 million AMI endpoints integrated and currently being rolled out, Kimbal is actively
supporting India’s national goal of deploying 250 million smart meters by 2028.
Does Kimbal offer end-to-end AMI project implementation?
Yes. Kimbal is a fully integrated [AMI solution][64] provider, from manufacturing smart meters and
communication hardware to deploying RF-Mesh networks, configuring the Head-End System, and providing
field workforce management tools.

Having a single partner for the entire end-to-end project lifecycle gives utilities a single,
accountable partner throughout the project. It also helps speed up deployments, simplify operations,
and maintain consistently low defect rates, ensuring smoother and more reliable smart metering
rollouts.
What is Ojas EnergyWatch application and who is the app designed for?
[Ojas EnergyWatch][65] is a smart meter mobile app built by Kimbal Innovation Lab. It delivers
real-time, personalized energy consumption data to end users, enabling utilities, property managers,
and sub metering providers to offer a single platform for transparency, billing visibility, and
seamless consumer communication. The app is purpose-built for a wide range of energy stakeholders
including sub metering providers, utilities and DISCOMs, property managers, energy service
providers, residential communities and commercial buildings.
What is Kimbal’s Energy Management Solution?
[Kimbal’s Energy Management Solution][66] helps commercial and industrial consumers reduce energy
costs by managing power more efficiently. The AI-driven platform automatically analyses tariffs,
market trends, and energy consumption to help businesses procure electricity at the best possible
prices.

With features like demand response, automated power trading on IEX, real-time monitoring, and
renewable energy integration, the platform enables smarter energy decisions, improved efficiency,
and 10%+ savings on energy bills.
What is Sub-Metering and how does Kimbal’s Intelligent Sub-Metering Solution help?
Sub-metering allows businesses to measure and monitor energy consumption at a granular level,
whether for individual tenants, departments, shared facilities, or specific equipment. It is
especially useful for secondary market spaces, such as commercial complexes, malls, campuses,
co-working spaces, and industrial parks, where tenants or multiple consumers need to be fairly
charged for their energy consumption.

[Kimbal’s intelligent sub-metering solutions][67] allow businesses to gain real-time energy
visibility, have accurate and transparent billing, and remote monitoring, helping organizations
identify energy wastage and optimize consumption. It also enables outage alerts, automated
reporting, and seamless communication, making infrastructure management simpler and more efficient.
With better visibility and control over energy usage, businesses can reduce operational costs,
improve billing efficiency, and achieve strong ROI.
What is Kimbal Mesh and what are its benefits for utilities?
[KMesh (Kimbal Mesh)][68] is Kimbal’s low-power RF mesh networking solution designed specifically
for smart meters, sensors, and gateways. It enables devices to communicate over multiple hops to
reliably connect and cover large geographic areas in dense networks without relying on a single
central point of coordination.

KMesh allows utilities to build fast-deploying networks that provide reliable connectivity and
guaranteed data delivery even in the challenging network
