### Future-proof your street lighting with open standards

[ [DALI Logo] ][93]
[ [TALQ Logo] ][94]
[ [ZHAGA Logo] ][95]

At Kurrant, we advocate for interoperability in street lighting systems. TALQ's openAPI enables
seamless communication between diverse solutions, ZHAGA ensures hardware interoperability across LED
modules and sensors, while DALI provides standardized lighting control protocols.

Interoperability isn't just a technical advantage—it's a strategic necessity that reduces costs,
increases innovation, and ensures your smart lighting infrastructure can evolve with the best
available technologies, regardless of manufacturer.

[Learn more][96]

At Kurrant, we advocate for interoperability in street lighting systems. TALQ's openAPI enables
seamless communication between diverse solutions, ZHAGA ensures hardware interoperability across LED
modules and sensors, while DALI provides standardized lighting control protocols.

increases innovation, and ensures your smart lighting infrastructure can evolve with the best
available technologies, regardless of manufacturer.

As a top energy management company in China, we are dedicated to providing 100% reliable and
high-quality smart meters, solar energy storage batteries, energy management software and effective
AMI solutions. It’s time to embrace the future of a more sustainable energy distribution. Through
these services and devices, we are changing the way businesses and consumers measure and optimize
energy, helping achieve a greener and more sustainable energy system that works better for
sustainability and efficiency.

Founded in 1996, **Londian** is a global leader in smart meter technology and energy innovation.
With cutting-edge R&D, advanced production, and reliable after-sales support, we’ve delivered **30
million+ smart meters** worldwide, empowering energy efficiency and sustainability.

**Our Mission:**
* Pioneer **smart metering solutions** for a low-carbon future.
* Drive **renewable energy infrastructure** and climate-target alignment.

महावितरण तुम्हाला कोणत्याही व्यक्तीशी संपर्क साधण्यास सांगत नाही

महावितरण केवळ **VM-MSEDCL / VK-MSEDCL / AM-MSEDCL / JM-MSEDCL** सारख्या SENDER ID वरून एसएमएस पाठवते आणि
कोणत्याही वैयक्तिक मोबाइल नंबरवरून एसएमएस पाठवत नाही.

महावितरण तुम्हाला कोणत्याही व्यक्तीशी संपर्क साधण्यास सांगत नाही

महावितरण केवळ **VM-MSEDCL / VK-MSEDCL / AM-MSEDCL / JM-MSEDCL** सारख्या SENDER ID वरून एसएमएस पाठवते आणि
कोणत्याही वैयक्तिक मोबाइल नंबरवरून एसएमएस पाठवत नाही.

## **METER Group is the world’s leading provider of advanced, cloud-connected, real-time
## soil-plant-atmospheric data ** that fuels environmental research at top universities, labs, and
## government agencies and drives progress in agricultural, geotechnical and industrial
## applications.

[[a researcher accessing ZENTRA Cloud data on a tablet while standing next to an ATMOS 41 weather
station in an open field]][154]
[Science][155]
As a researcher, you need high-quality, precision instrumentation. That's why METER scientists are a
key part of our effort in developing research-grade instruments to help you understand complex
environmental interactions.
[LEARN MORE ][156]
[Engineering][157]
We know that thorough analyses of soil moisture, thermal properties, and other mechanics are
critical for any structural or environmental engineering project. METER instruments gather these
data accurately, without adding unnecessary complexity.
[LEARN MORE ][158]
[[A photograph of a pivot irrigation system watering a field of crops]][159]
[Agriculture][160]
Every farm investment has to be weighed against the bottom line. That's why we design solutions that
provide data to help you use irrigation more effectively, reduce disease, lower pumping costs,
control nutrient leaching, and get the most yield from your crops.
[LEARN MORE ][161]
[Climate and weather][162]
Microclimate monitoring is critical to understand how water moves through an environment, and we
design solutions to measure meteorological phenomena local to a project. METER sensors, instruments,
and weather stations capture a wide range of measurements to ensure you have the data you need.
[LEARN MORE ][163]

###### NEW PRODUCT RELEASE

# SOLYX 14

Meet the next-generation in soil moisture sensing: the SOLYX 14, powered by complex dielectric with
intersections (CDX) technology. Minimize errors and barriers due to soil salinity by directly
measuring real and imaginary dielectric permittivity, enabling accurate long-term soil moisture
measurement in more conditions than ever before.

## Login Options

Take control of your meter.

### Residential Tenants/Owners

#### RegisterNew Users
* Instant access for Protea Metering clients with Smart Meters
* Tenants or Owners
* Valid E-mail address and Cellphone number required
* Register Multiple Users
* Registration is easy and free

[Click here to REGISTER][12]

### Residential Tenants/Owners

#### LoginRegistered Users
* View balance/available credit
* View daily, weekly and monthly usage
* View monthly water and electricity graphs
* View predicted usage
* Set up notifications to warn if you are running low
* Purchase prepaid electricity/Top-up your account

[Click here to LOGIN][13]

### Managing agents/Landlords

#### LL LoginFor prevetted Property Managers
* Financial breakdowns (Income & Expenses, Levy Rolls
* Shared Services (Consumption & Recovery)
* Water and Electricity Schematics & Audits
* Resident management (Low/High credit & usage)
* Credit Control, Monthly reports and more...

[Click here to LOGIN][14]

## About your OAMI Account

Registration for your OAMI account is free. Once you have registered you will have full access to
your OAMI account. This means that you will be able to view and monitor your usage, view your
statement, make payments (via debit order, credit card or EFT) online, purchase electricity via SMS,
receive low credit SMS notifications, and much much more. Once you have topped up your account the
credit token will be automatically delivered to your meter (if you have a smart prepaid meter).
* E-wallet accounts: Daily consumptions will be deducted from your available credit on your
  e-wallet. If you have credit, you will have electricity
* Prepaid accounts: Once you have topped up your account the credit token will be automatically
  delivered to your meter (if you have a smart prepaid meter).
* 10+ methods available to top-up your account.

This service is only available for Protea Metering clients. If you are unsure if you should register
on OAMI, please feel free to contact our friendly call centre agents. All our contact details can be
viewed at [www.ProteaMetering.co.za][15].
If you are a property developer, body corporate or managing agent and would like to make use of the
OAMI system, please contact our marketing department via [www.ProteaMetering.co.za][16].

**IMPORTANT:** You must have an OAMI installed smart meter to make use of the functionality. You
must register an account to be able to top up your account. Administration costs may be charged by
your provider on transactions. Our sites are designed with the latest technology such as HTML 5 and
javascript. If you have an older browser such as Internet Explorer 6, 7 or 8 you may have limited
functionality on your account. We advise that you download and install a modern browser such as
Mozilla Firefox or Google Chrome.

[Learn More][17]

electricity usage.

  Advantages of OAMI:
  ▸ Deeper Industry-specific functionality
  ▸ Full- and partial-scale implementation has a lower total cost per meter<
  ▸ Better Asset and Resource Management
  ▸ Sustainability
  ▸ Better Customer Service
  ▸ Transparency
* [02 Services to domestic consumers (Residents/Tenants/Owners) ][19]
  
  ▸ Token delivery: Purchase your prepaid electricity token online and we will deliver it to your

Polaris, formerly Gram Power, is one of the leading smart metering solution providers in India. In a
world overrun with quick fixes, we work ground up to solve core issues in critical energy
infrastructure and don’t shy away from radical ideas. We’ve made big impacts with our innovative
strategies, data insights and technical acumen.

## Our Mission & Vision

Driving India's energy transformation through innovation and excellence.

### Our Mission

Provide cutting edge energy solutions for promoting sustainable and efficient energy management and
distribution globally.

[Our Mission]

### Our Vision

Empowering a world where everyone has access to reliable, clean, and affordable energy, enabled by
intelligent technology.

[Our Vision]

Like the North Star that has guided explorers for centuries, Polaris represents our unwavering
commitment to being the guiding light in India's energy transformation.

[Navigation Icon]

Sustainability drives our engineering. By improving energy efficiency and enabling clean energy

SMART World. SMART Future.

## Our Journey

[Grid] [Grid]

### Bringing power to India with Microgrids

#### 2010

Yashraj Khaitan came to India while studying in UC Berkley, inspired by the ingenious workarounds of
people in India - built 40 microgrids in Rajasthan and UP.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### Bihar | 2018

Among the early pioneers in smart metering, Gram Power, now Polaris, was appointed by SBPDCL to
drive advanced metering infrastructure and strengthen power distribution in South Bihar.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### Ladakh & Kargil | 2022

Gram Power, now Polaris, was amongst the first few to get appointed as an AMISP with REC. Awarded
10-year contract to manage the Ladakh & Kargil UTs for power distribution and smart metering.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### Uttar Pradesh | 2023

Amongst the early AMISPs selected by MVVNL, Polaris, formerly Gram Power, was awarded the mandate
for smart metering and power distribution modernisation in the Gomati and Saryu regions.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### Manipur | 2024

Selected as AMISP by MSPDCL, Polaris was awarded the responsibility to implement smart metering and
manage power distribution operations in the Sangai region.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### West Bengal | 2024

Appointed as AMISP by WBSEDCL, Polaris began operations in the Hooghly district with a long-term
engagement for smart metering and distribution system enhancements.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Commencement of Supply of Smart Gas Meters

#### THINK Gas | 2025

Polaris commenced the supply of Prepaid Smart Gas Meters to THINK Gas across its geographical areas,
spread across 49 districts in 10 states.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Supply & Service Agreement for Prepaid Smart Gas Meters

#### Megha Gas | 2025

Polaris has signed a supply & service agreement for 0.6Mn Prepaid Smart Gas Meters with Megha Gas
across its geographical areas, spread across 62 districts in 10 states.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

## Our Journey

[Grid] [Grid]

### Bringing power to India with Microgrids

#### 2010

Yashraj Khaitan came to India while studying in UC Berkley, inspired by the ingenious workarounds of
people in India - built 40 microgrids in Rajasthan and UP.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### Bihar | 2018

Among the early pioneers in smart metering, Gram Power, now Polaris, was appointed by SBPDCL to
drive advanced metering infrastructure and strengthen power distribution in South Bihar.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### Ladakh & Kargil | 2022

Gram Power, now Polaris, was amongst the first few to get appointed as an AMISP with REC. Awarded
10-year contract to manage the Ladakh & Kargil UTs for power distribution and smart metering.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### Uttar Pradesh | 2023

Amongst the early AMISPs selected by MVVNL, Polaris, formerly Gram Power, was awarded the mandate
for smart metering and power distribution modernisation in the Gomati and Saryu regions.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### Manipur | 2024

Selected as AMISP by MSPDCL, Polaris was awarded the responsibility to implement smart metering and
manage power distribution operations in the Sangai region.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Appointed as AMISP

#### West Bengal | 2024

Appointed as AMISP by WBSEDCL, Polaris began operations in the Hooghly district with a long-term
engagement for smart metering and distribution system enhancements.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Commencement of Supply of Smart Gas Meters

#### THINK Gas | 2025

Polaris commenced the supply of Prepaid Smart Gas Meters to THINK Gas across its geographical areas,
spread across 49 districts in 10 states.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

### Supply & Service Agreement for Prepaid Smart Gas Meters

#### Megha Gas | 2025

Polaris has signed a supply & service agreement for 0.6Mn Prepaid Smart Gas Meters with Megha Gas
across its geographical areas, spread across 62 districts in 10 states.

[Bringing power to India with microgrids]

旺玖科技為一家全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商，專注於 USB
智慧型輸出入控制晶片、機電整合技術及智慧綠色能源解決方案。旺玖科技提供的晶片系統整合解決方案，包含

月，公司總部設於台灣，並於中國大陸、美國、日本、韓國等地區設有銷售服務據點。

About Prolific

## 旺玖科技

### 全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商

旺玖科技為一家全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商，專注於 USB
智慧型輸出入控制晶片、機電整合技術及智慧綠色能源解決方案。旺玖科技提供的晶片系統整合解決方案，包含
USB 介面橋接晶片、USB
儲存產品、無刷馬達控制器、霍爾原件感測器、智能電表及微機電感測器相關產品。旺玖科技成立於 1997 年 11
月，公司總部設於台灣，並於中國大陸、美國、日本、韓國等地區設有銷售服務據點。

About Prolific

## 旺玖科技

### 全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商

旺玖科技為一家全球知名的 IC 設計領導廠商，專注於 USB
智慧型輸出入控制晶片、機電整合技術及智慧綠色能源解決方案。旺玖科技提供的晶片系統整合解決方案，包含
USB 介面橋接晶片、USB
儲存產品、無刷馬達控制器、霍爾原件感測器、智能電表及微機電感測器相關產品。旺玖科技成立於 1997 年 11
月，公司總部設於台灣，並於中國大陸、美國、日本、韓國等地區設有銷售服務據點。

### What we do

Multi-national solutions provider for revenue management, power quality and energy efficiency that
enable users to save money, reduce energy consumption and facilitates comfortable living.

[Learn more][297]
Stand: A301
**23^{rd} – 28^{th} August 2026**
Palais des Congrès, Paris, France

### Semsites' stories

Inspiring narratives of our people, providing insight into their personal growth, resilience, and
perseverance. These stories are a reminder of how Secure positively impacted the lives of its
people, empowered them and provided them support to overcome challenges with determination and grit.

[Read more][298]

# Innovative, nachhaltige
# und wirtschaftliche Systemlösungen
# für die Energiebranche

## Damit Sie zukunftssicher mit EFR steuern, messen und kommunizieren.

[Serviceprovider Netzsteuerung][57]
[Unsere Systemlösungen][58]
[Mehr über uns erfahren][59]

### Seit 30 Jahren vertrauen mehr als 350 Unternehmen und Kommunen unseren Systemlösungen.

## Unsere Systemlösungen für die Energiebranche

Die EFR-Systemlösungen umfassen alles Erforderliche für das Management und die
End-to-End-Kommunikation: Software, mehrere Kommunikationskanäle zur Auswahl und die passenden
Hardwarekomponenten.
Ziel ist die zuverlässige Umsetzung von Netzführungsaufgaben.

Da alle Komponenten des Systems aufeinander abgestimmt sind, lassen sich die EFR-System-Lösungen
auch bei umfassender Funktionalität einfach einführen und bedienen.

### Bereit für den Smart-Grid-Rollout?

Wir haben ein Vollservice-Angebot für das Einspeisemanagement nach § 9 EEG und das Steuern nach §
14a EnWG für Sie entwickelt.

[Unser Pilotsystem][60]

### Tarif- und Laststeuerung

Für die Tarif- und Laststeuerung bieten wir Lösungen mit dem EFR-Langwellen-Broadcastsystem, unsere
Hybridlösung oder die modulare Softwareplattform GMS.

[Unsere Tarif- und Laststeuerung][61]

### Redispatch 2.0 / Einspeisemanagement

Die faire Lösung, um Einspeiser erneuerbarer Energie ans Netz zu nehmen und Überlastungen zu
vermeiden. Intuitiv zu bedienen, sicher in der Anwendung. 

[Unser Redispatch 2.0 / Einspeisemanagement][62]

### Beleuchtungssteuerung

Unser auf Langwelle basierende Lösung zum Steuern der öffentlichen Beleuchtung – preiswert, schnell
und zuverlässig. 

[Unsere Beleuchtungssteuerung][63]

### M2M Mobilfunk

Die einfache Lösung zur Anbindung IP-basierter Endgeräte. Zum kleinen Tarif, aber mit einer
großartigen Netzverfügbarkeit. 

[Unser M2M Mobilfunk][64]

### Prädiktive Gebäudesteuerung

Ein Langwellen-Datenservice und Empfangsgeräte, die beim Heizen und Kühlen Klimaschutz- und
Sparpotenziale eröffnen.

[Unser Prädiktive Gebäudesteuerung][65]

## Über die EFR GmbH

Die EFR GmbH ist ein Systemanbieter im Bereich Energiemanagement in Deutschland und Mitteleuropa.

Unter dem Motto „Zukunftssicher Steuern, Messen, Kommunizieren“ bietet EFR Komplettlösungen für das
digitale Netzmanagement des Smart Grid.

[Unser Unternehmen][66]

## Wir sind zertifiziert!

Die EFR GmbH betreibt ein Qualitäts-Management-System (QMS)
und ein Informationssicherheits-Management-System (ISMS) und ist zertifiziert nach:

#### ISO 9001:2015

#### ISO/IEC 27001:2022

####  ISO 14001:2015

[Unsere Zertifikate][67]

# Innovative, nachhaltige
# und wirtschaftliche Systemlösungen
# für die Energiebranche

## Damit Sie zukunftssicher mit EFR steuern, messen und kommunizieren.

[Serviceprovider Netzsteuerung][57]
[Unsere Systemlösungen][58]
[Mehr über uns erfahren][59]

### Seit 30 Jahren vertrauen mehr als 350 Unternehmen und Kommunen unseren Systemlösungen.

## Unsere Systemlösungen für die Energiebranche

Die EFR-Systemlösungen umfassen alles Erforderliche für das Management und die
End-to-End-Kommunikation: Software, mehrere Kommunikationskanäle zur Auswahl und die passenden
Hardwarekomponenten.
Ziel ist die zuverlässige Umsetzung von Netzführungsaufgaben.

Da alle Komponenten des Systems aufeinander abgestimmt sind, lassen sich die EFR-System-Lösungen
auch bei umfassender Funktionalität einfach einführen und bedienen.

### Bereit für den Smart-Grid-Rollout?

Wir haben ein Vollservice-Angebot für das Einspeisemanagement nach § 9 EEG und das Steuern nach §
14a EnWG für Sie entwickelt.

[Unser Pilotsystem][60]

### Tarif- und Laststeuerung

Für die Tarif- und Laststeuerung bieten wir Lösungen mit dem EFR-Langwellen-Broadcastsystem, unsere
Hybridlösung oder die modulare Softwareplattform GMS.

[Unsere Tarif- und Laststeuerung][61]

### Redispatch 2.0 / Einspeisemanagement

Die faire Lösung, um Einspeiser erneuerbarer Energie ans Netz zu nehmen und Überlastungen zu
vermeiden. Intuitiv zu bedienen, sicher in der Anwendung. 

[Unser Redispatch 2.0 / Einspeisemanagement][62]

### Beleuchtungssteuerung

Unser auf Langwelle basierende Lösung zum Steuern der öffentlichen Beleuchtung – preiswert, schnell
und zuverlässig. 

[Unsere Beleuchtungssteuerung][63]

### M2M Mobilfunk

Die einfache Lösung zur Anbindung IP-basierter Endgeräte. Zum kleinen Tarif, aber mit einer
großartigen Netzverfügbarkeit. 

[Unser M2M Mobilfunk][64]

### Prädiktive Gebäudesteuerung

Ein Langwellen-Datenservice und Empfangsgeräte, die beim Heizen und Kühlen Klimaschutz- und
Sparpotenziale eröffnen.

[Unser Prädiktive Gebäudesteuerung][65]

## Über die EFR GmbH

Die EFR GmbH ist ein Systemanbieter im Bereich Energiemanagement in Deutschland und Mitteleuropa.

Unter dem Motto „Zukunftssicher Steuern, Messen, Kommunizieren“ bietet EFR Komplettlösungen für das
digitale Netzmanagement des Smart Grid.

[Unser Unternehmen][66]

## Wir sind zertifiziert!

Die EFR GmbH betreibt ein Qualitäts-Management-System (QMS)
und ein Informationssicherheits-Management-System (ISMS) und ist zertifiziert nach:

#### ISO 9001:2015

#### ISO/IEC 27001:2022

####  ISO 14001:2015

[Unsere Zertifikate][67]

Komplett-Portfolio aus modernen Messeinrichtungen, SMGw (BSI-CC-1000) und Steuerboxen.

Im Kompetenznetzwerk der EFR GmbH mit den Standorten in München, Berlin und Wutha-Farnroda
(Thüringen) sowie mit einem leistungsstarken Fertigungspartner im asiatischen Wirtschaftsraum werden

# Smart Meters

## What is SmartMe?

SmartMe is an independent UK website explaining how electricity and gas smart meters work.

The site provides clear technical explanations of the UK smart meter system, including how smart
meters communicate, the differences between SMETS1 and SMETS2 meters, and how consumers can monitor
and understand their energy usage.

SmartMe was created by engineers with experience in smart meter technology and energy systems. The
goal of the site is to provide accurate, easy-to-understand information about smart meters, how they
operate, and how they affect households across the United Kingdom.

Topics covered on SmartMe include:
* How smart meters work
* SMETS1 vs SMETS2 meters
* Smart meter communications networks
* Home Area Networks and In-Home Displays
* The UK smart meter rollout
* Common smart meter questions and problems.

## The truth about Smart Meters - the good and the bad

[Simple diagram showing how meters and IHD connect.]

Energy supply companies have been installing smart meters for electricity and gas in homes across
Great Britain since 2012. By 2025, all residential and small businesses across England, Scotland and
Wales will be offered a smart meter by their energy supplier.

In Northern Ireland the Department for the Economy (DfE) has recommended an electricity smart meter
roll-out over six years starting in 2027. A gas roll-out won't be included as the benefits were not
sufficient.

A smart meter sends an electronic meter reading to your energy supplier, meaning:
* they won't need to take a manual meter reading - as the meters send back readings themselves
* you won't get estimated bills - as actual readings are available
* it'll be easier to switch energy suppliers - as the reading at changeover is readily available
* there should be less arguments - as the readings are reliable and not subject to disagreement.

You'll also get a digital display in your home, helping you to keep track of how much energy you're
using and how much it's costing.

You won't have to pay for your smart meter or digital display up front - the cost will be included
in everyone's energy bill over the next few years.

A smart meter won't change how you currently pay for your energy bill, e.g. monthly, or prepaid.
This will still be determined by the product and payment method you choose.

Smart Meters and their roll-out haven't been perfect and they've been the subject of negative
headlines. What do these headlines really mean?

  * **Incorrect Bills** - When the Smart Meters fail to send in readings suppliers use estimates.
    This can go on for a while and can sometimes result in an unexpectedly large bill when a reading
    finally gets through.
    The meters are still recording accurately so customers just need to check their bill is not
    using estimates and send in a [manual reading][36] if necessary. If you do not want to check

headlines. What do these headlines really mean?
* **Smart Meters don't work** - this headline has covered different problems over time, so let's
  break it down into the different reasons:
  * **Incorrect Bills** - When the Smart Meters fail to send in readings suppliers use estimates.
    This can go on for a while and can sometimes result in an unexpectedly large bill when a reading
    finally gets through.
    The meters are still recording accurately so customers just need to check their bill is not
    using estimates and send in a [manual reading][36] if necessary. If you do not want to check
    your bill just send in a meter reading every month as you would with a traditional meter.

    their kitchen their “meter”. So, when that doesn't work they complain their meter is not
    working. Their meter is working and recording energy accurately but, frustratingly, they cannot
    see that on the IHD. They have to go to their meter to [read][37] their consumption.
    Solutions to the IHD being too far away from the Comms Hub are being investigated by the [Alt
    HAN Co Ltd][38].
  * **No communications** - Communication with the meters is essential to set up tariffs and
    prepayment mode. Without communications your meter will operate as a traditional one rate meter,
    and you'll have to take your own readings. Understandably customers get very frustrated when
    their meters can't communicate and yet they have a good mobile signal and a good broadband
    connection. Progress to find alternative solutions for the [Wide Area Network (WAN)][39] have
    been slow which is again frustrating as the barriers to a solution are not technical but
    political.

    different management systems and could not always be supported when a customer changed supplier
    as the systems tended to be supplier specific. [SMETS 2][41] meters do not have this problem as
    a common system is used operated by the Data Communications Company (DCC).

  different, a different communications system was setup for the two areas. Each system has pros and
  cons but sensibly a longer-range radio system was used in the North. However, customers in the
  North can get frustrated when they have a perfectly good mobile phone signal and the Long Range
  Radio signal to their meter is too weak for communication to work successfully. This has now been
  addressed as mobile 4G communications can be used in Scotland and the North of England from
  30^{th} May 2025.

  information on our [SMETS 2][42] page.

meters as our team do not have expertise in that area.

# Smart Meters

## What is SmartMe?

SmartMe is an independent UK website explaining how electricity and gas smart meters work.

The site provides clear technical explanations of the UK smart meter system, including how smart
meters communicate, the differences between SMETS1 and SMETS2 meters, and how consumers can monitor
and understand their energy usage.

SmartMe was created by engineers with experience in smart meter technology and energy systems. The
goal of the site is to provide accurate, easy-to-understand information about smart meters, how they
operate, and how they affect households across the United Kingdom.

Topics covered on SmartMe include:
* How smart meters work
* SMETS1 vs SMETS2 meters
* Smart meter communications networks
* Home Area Networks and In-Home Displays
* The UK smart meter rollout
* Common smart meter questions and problems.

## The truth about Smart Meters - the good and the bad

[Simple diagram showing how meters and IHD connect.]

Energy supply companies have been installing smart meters for electricity and gas in homes across
Great Britain since 2012. By 2025, all residential and small businesses across England, Scotland and
Wales will be offered a smart meter by their energy supplier.

In Northern Ireland the Department for the Economy (DfE) has recommended an electricity smart meter
roll-out over six years starting in 2027. A gas roll-out won't be included as the benefits were not
sufficient.

A smart meter sends an electronic meter reading to your energy supplier, meaning:
* they won't need to take a manual meter reading - as the meters send back readings themselves
* you won't get estimated bills - as actual readings are available
* it'll be easier to switch energy suppliers - as the reading at changeover is readily available
* there should be less arguments - as the readings are reliable and not subject to disagreement.

You'll also get a digital display in your home, helping you to keep track of how much energy you're
using and how much it's costing.

You won't have to pay for your smart meter or digital display up front - the cost will be included
in everyone's energy bill over the next few years.

A smart meter won't change how you currently pay for your energy bill, e.g. monthly, or prepaid.
This will still be determined by the product and payment method you choose.

Smart Meters and their roll-out haven't been perfect and they've been the subject of negative
headlines. What do these headlines really mean?
* **Smart Meters don't work** - this headline has covered different problems over time, so let's
  break it down into the different reasons:
  * **Incorrect Bills** - When the Smart Meters fail to send in readings suppliers use estimates.
    This can go on for a while and can sometimes result in an unexpectedly large bill when a reading
    finally gets through.
    The meters are still recording accurately so customers just need to check their bill is not
    using estimates and send in a [manual reading][36] if necessary. If you do not want to check
    your bill just send in a meter reading every month as you would with a traditional meter.
  * **IHD not working** - Many customers call the In Home Device that usually sits on the worktop in
    their kitchen their “meter”. So, when that doesn't work they complain their meter is not
    working. Their meter is working and recording energy accurately but, frustratingly, they cannot
    see that on the IHD. They have to go to their meter to [read][37] their consumption.
    Solutions to the IHD being too far away from the Comms Hub are being investigated by the [Alt
    HAN Co Ltd][38].
  * **No communications** - Communication with the meters is essential to set up tariffs and
    prepayment mode. Without communications your meter will operate as a traditional one rate meter,
    and you'll have to take your own readings. Understandably customers get very frustrated when
    their meters can't communicate and yet they have a good mobile signal and a good broadband
    connection. Progress to find alternative solutions for the [Wide Area Network (WAN)][39] have
    been slow which is again frustrating as the barriers to a solution are not technical but
    political.
  * **Stops working after changing supplier** - Older [SMETS 1][40] meters operated on many
    different management systems and could not always be supported when a customer changed supplier
    as the systems tended to be supplier specific. [SMETS 2][41] meters do not have this problem as
    a common system is used operated by the Data Communications Company (DCC).
* **North South Divide** - As the characteristics of the North and South of the country are
  different, a different communications system was setup for the two areas. Each system has pros and
  cons but sensibly a longer-range radio system was used in the North. However, customers in the
  North can get frustrated when they have a perfectly good mobile phone signal and the Long Range
  Radio signal to their meter is too weak for communication to work successfully. This has now been
  addressed as mobile 4G communications can be used in Scotland and the North of England from
  30^{th} May 2025.
  So, one could now argue that the North has better communications options than the South. See more
  information on our [SMETS 2][42] page.

Many people have questions about Smart Meters, this website tries to answer them honestly for
electricity and gas meters, thoroughly and without bias. This site does not deal with Smart water
meters as our team do not have expertise in that area.

## [PG&E Applying for Half Billion to Replace Aging Gas Meters- Electric Next?][41]

Posted on [April 1, 2024][42] by [Josh Hart][43]
**We told you smart meters don’t last long and now the bill has come due…**
Nina B. of [SmartMeterHarm.org][44] reports: PG&E wants $498 million to replace the AMI modules on
the Smart gas meters because the modules are “approaching the end of their expected useful life,” 
according to PG&E’s notice in the Monterey County Herald. PG&E filed Application A.24-03-011,  March
14.
The notice also states “Starting in 2027, further costs will be included in the General Rate Case
process.” It’s unclear if they mean AMI/Smart Meter costs. If PG&E means to replace the electric
Smart Meters, the costs will be astronomical.
Does PG&E expect those who don’t have Smart Meters to pay these costs? Probably. Stay tuned.
PG&E application:
[https://docs.cpuc.ca.gov/PublishedDocs/Efile/G000/M527/K230/527230482.PDF][45]

according to PG&E’s notice in the Monterey County Herald. PG&E filed Application A.24-03-011,  March

process.” It’s unclear if they mean AMI/Smart Meter costs. If PG&E means to replace the electric

in India. We are committed to bringing a difference in the solar energy arena as we promise clean,

Sun-AP Ecopower is India’s most trusted, experienced, and pure play [solar panels distributor][263]

scaling operations and efficiency as per global benchmarks.

  over time, become clogged with dirt, or even be tampered with with magnets, all of which can cause
  them to lose accuracy. The advent of ultrasonic water meters has become a new solution for
  resolving these disputes.
